title: Interactive maps with markers

requirements.text: An interactive map renders with pan, zoom and the tile provider attribution the provider requires
Markers are placed from application data at validated latitude/longitude coordinates
Marker popups and tooltips render user-supplied text escaped, never as raw HTML
Large numbers of markers are clustered or virtualized so the map stays responsive
The initial viewport fits the visible markers, with a sensible default when there are none
Markers are reachable by keyboard and have accessible names; a list alternative exists
Only markers the viewer is authorized to see (tenant-scoped) are loaded, bounded by the viewport or a limit
Map provider keys are restricted (domain/usage) and no secret key reaches the browser

implementations.notes: External MIT React map components for markers and routes; basemap and tile services have separate terms

notes: No Genlib map component. Building blocks: capability:tile-math (tiles and Mercator), capability:geo (haversine, bounding box), html-escape recipe for popup text, module:rbac for scoping.
